headline.text: L1 S3 metal detector failed to reject test cards at startup — X-ray caught metal later, *MD did not*. Line held, MD adjusted, now passing.

summary: Three active holds today: L1 S3 jar line held for metal detector failure; two boxes at L2 ML2 pulled for missing batch codes; L1 S2 held while maintenance replaced bearing with missing balls. Four sanitation gaps flagged — weekend cleaning left swecos/magnets dirty at L1 S1 and S3, butter tank uncleaned at S4, and sticky caramel at S2 capper.

holds.title: S3 jar line held — metal detector failure
holds.summary: Metal detector failed to reject test cards at startup; X-ray later caught metal-in-product that MD missed. Line held, MD adjusted by maintenance, now rejecting correctly.
holds.status: Resolved — MD adjusted at 08:05, cards reading correctly, line released.

holds.title: S2 line held — bearing failure, missing balls
holds.summary: Decrystalizer bearing destroyed with balls missing; potential foreign material in product zone. Line shut down, bearing replaced, chocolate emptied for inspection.
holds.status: Resolved — bearing replaced in 40 minutes, line restarted at 11:50. Maintenance confirms balls cannot enter pump (fell to floor).

holds.title: ML2 boxes held — missing batch code
holds.summary: Videojet printer shut off during run; two boxes reached pack area without printed lot code. Boxes pulled from line and isolated for inspection.
holds.status: On hold pending QA disposition — two boxes isolated, awaiting decision.

food_safety.title: S2 tunnel roller creating shavings
food_safety.summary: Tunnel 3 assembly error — roller cover hitting side, creating small metal shavings. Caught during maintenance inspection after bearing replacement.
food_safety.status: Open, awaiting maintenance fix — assembly wasn't done correctly, producing shavings.

food_safety.title: S1 metal debris on floor near MD
food_safety.summary: Metal debris found on floor in MD area and S1 incline belt zone this morning. Production cleaned, QA inspected, ATP passed.
food_safety.status: Resolved — area cleaned, ATP passed, QA released.

food_safety.title: S3 foreign material during belt change
food_safety.summary: Found foreign material under Z-belt during routine wire replacement on pack line. QA consulted on next steps; area cleaned.
food_safety.status: Resolved — QA assessed as non-product-contact zone, cleaned, released.

food_safety.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 belt fraying
food_safety.summary: Infeed belt on Cavanna 1 shifting, fraying, leaving material behind. Line paused, belt repositioned, area cleaned, QA inspected before restart.
food_safety.status: Resolved — lead adjusted belt/scrapers, QA inspected at 07:19, released to run. Monitoring ongoing.

food_safety.title: S1 MD extra rejection after test
food_safety.summary: Metal detector opened one extra time after 1:30 PM card check completed successfully. QA monitoring for recurrence.
food_safety.status: Open, monitoring — cards read correctly but extra reject triggered; will report if repeats.

quality.title: ML1 equipment assembly errors
quality.summary: Sweco screen installed backwards; brass gasket in wrong position causing piston failures. Both caught at startup, corrected by operators.
quality.status: Resolved — operators corrected both, depositing properly by 07:11. Flagged for weekend cleaning crew review.

quality.title: ML4 broken bars at demolding
quality.summary: Chocolate accumulation on inverter plate causing bars to break at demolding. Operators caught, cleaned plate, issue resolved.
quality.status: Resolved — plate cleaned at 10:27, no further broken bars observed.

sanitation.title: S1 swecos/magnets left dirty
sanitation.summary: Swecos and magnets found dirty this morning at S1 — same issue as S3. Part of shutdown checklist not followed over weekend.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleaned by day shift. Coaching required for weekend crew on shutdown checklist.

sanitation.title: S3 swecos/magnets left dirty
sanitation.summary: Swecos and magnets found dirty this morning — should have been cleaned at end of weekend run. Operators cleaned during shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleaned by day shift. Shutdown checklist adherence flagged for coaching.

sanitation.title: S4 butter tank not cleaned over weekend
sanitation.summary: Heavy burnt butter buildup found on melting grate this morning — should have been cleaned as part of weekend shutdown checklist.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleaned during lunch rotation. Coaching required; part of shutdown SOP.

sanitation.title: S2 capper belts sticky with caramel
sanitation.summary: Capper and labeling area belts stained with sticky caramel. Cleaning performed; wrong cleaning solution suspected (sanitizer instead of degreaser).
sanitation.status: Resolved — area cleaned. Solution identified as sanitizer; coaching on chemical selection.

sanitation.title: ML4 mold turner not cleaned
sanitation.summary: Mold turner found uncleaned at startup — missed during weekend cleaning. Flagged during first-shift inspection.
sanitation.status: Open — flagged for follow-up with weekend cleaning crew.

sanitation.title: ML4 gondola exit rollers very dirty
sanitation.summary: Gondola exit rollers received very dirty at startup. Team cleaned rollers before start.
sanitation.status: Resolved — team cleaned at 05:30 before startup.

opportunities.text: Consider adding sweco/magnet cleaning verification photo to S1 and S3 weekend shutdown checklists — based on both lines starting Monday with dirty equipment that should have been cleaned per SOP.
Review S4 weekend shutdown checklist sign-off process — butter tank buildup suggests checklist steps were marked complete without actual inspection.
Add MD test-card verification to S3 startup checklist as hard stop before product release — based on MD failing cards while X-ray caught metal downstream.
Consider adding critical assembly steps (gasket position, sweco orientation) with photos to ML1 weekend cleaning checklist — based on two separate assembly errors caught at startup today.
Review ML4 weekend cleaning sign-off procedure — checklist had only 2 of 12+ items signed off, yet line was released; mold turner also missed.
